name: conqueror_gear5_charge
author: HexPiece 2.5.1
description: Conqueror's Haki charge (neutral): the fists clench and pull in at the waist, the elbows flared; as it fills the body hunches over the fists, the fists rise under the chest, the head hangs then lifts to glare, the breath heaves faster and a tremor grows, shudders jolting it; at full charge it holds coiled, shaking hard. The upper body only.
